title: The smoke tiers boot only the published image name
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)
details: `SMOKE_IMAGE` and `SBX_IMAGE` are the published names `cs-sandbox version --images` prints, passed as `CS_SANDBOX_IMAGE`. An image `cs-sandbox build` makes of an unpublished version is now tagged under localhost/ instead. So a campaign pinned at a local sandbox build rebuilds the image on every run and boots a name no host holds.
